data.one_liner: Create and customize local and push notifications in Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: A complete solution to create local and push notifications with custom buttons, images, sounds, emoticons, and multiple layouts. It handles real-time user interaction events and scheduled notifications.
use_when: You need rich, highly customizable local or push notifications with images, action buttons, or special layouts.
You require real-time event handling when notifications are displayed, dismissed, or tapped by the user.
avoid_when: You are already using `flutter_local_notifications` or another conflicting notification plugin.
You only need extremely simple notifications and want to avoid complex native configuration steps.
strengths: Supports multiple rich notification layouts (big picture, inbox, media, messaging, progress bars).
Provides real-time event tracking for notification lifecycle actions.
Allows scheduling notifications with second precision.
weaknesses: Incompatible with other third-party notification plugins like `flutter_local_notifications`.
Requires manual configuration of native manifests, permissions, and Podfiles depending on the version.
data.setup_notes: Requires specific native configuration including minimum iOS deployment targets (iOS 15.0), Android SDK configurations, manual permissions in AndroidManifest.xml, and modifications to Podfiles.

alternatives.name: flutter_local_notifications
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a widely-used alternative for local notifications that does not conflict with specific core libraries, though it has different customization capabilities.

alternatives.name: onesignal_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want an all-in-one hosted push notification service rather than building a custom local/push pipeline.
